project.title: Next-Generation Sequencing for Microbial Community Analysis in Activated Sludge to Enhance Biodegradation of Azo Dyes in Textile Industry Wastewater
project.description: Aim of the WorkThis study aimed to evaluate the potential of activated sludge for the decolorization of Reactive Black 5 (RB5) from textile wastewater, optimize the main operational parameters affecting the process, and characterize the associated bacterial community using 16S rRNA gene next-generation sequencing (NGS). The study also sought to provide a basis for developing a sustainable biological treatment system for textile wastewater.More specifically, the work aimed to:* Screen activated sludge samples for their RB5 decolorization efficiency.* Optimize pH, dye concentration, and salinity using response surface methodology (RSM).* Determine RB5 decolorization efficiency spectrophotometrically at 597 nm.* Characterize the bacterial community of the selected activated sludge using 16S rRNA gene sequencing.* Assess the potential of the selected microbial consortium for future application in sustainable textile wastewater treatment and biofilter systems.
